[PREFERENCE] User is looking for a chocolate cake recipe similar to a traditional, moist, and rich chocolate cake.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a classic moist chocolate cake recipe with the following details:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ingredients for the cake: 2 ¾ cups all-purpose flour, 1 ½ cups granulated sugar, 2 teaspoons baking powder, 1 teaspoon salt, 1 cup unsweetened cocoa powder, 1 cup whole milk, 2 large eggs, 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ingredients for the chocolate buttercream frosting: 1 cup unsalted butter, 2 cups confectioners' sugar, 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder, 2 tablespoons milk or heavy cream, 1 teaspoon vanilla extract.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for the cake include preheating the oven, mixing dry and wet ingredients, baking, and cooling.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for the frosting include beating butter, adding sugar and cocoa, and mixing until smooth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for ensuring the cake is moist and flavorful.  
[PREFERENCE] User thinks the chocolate cake recipe sounds amazing and plans to try it for the summer party.
